# image orientation

The clockwise rotation of an image from its normal orientation, in degrees (EXIF convention: 0, 90, 180, 270). Functional: one orientation per manifestation. Transform math lives in the solver layer (Principle 12).

**IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/imageOrientation>  
**CURIE:** `gmeow:imageOrientation`  

**Type:** `owl:DatatypeProperty`, `owl:FunctionalProperty`  

**Defined by:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/slices/documents>
